_avail.description: 9.5" mixing amplifier 70 - 100 volt / 60 watts, 1 mic/line input, 2 stereo line inputs, left to right 4 level priority system, Emergency in, paging mic with chime, 24V override output
_avail.portsMissing: Not stated: emergency input, priority-out and mains inlet connector types (set to other). The data sheet says the mic input takes Euroblock or RCA, the manual mentions only Euroblock; check the panel for an RCA jack

ports.label: Emergency In
ports.notes: Balanced 0 dBV line level; triggered by potential-free contact on the mute all connection; connector type not stated

ports.label: Paging Mic In
ports.notes: Balanced mic level on Euroblock; paging contact mutes lower priorities and plays chime

ports.label: Paging Line In (RCA)
ports.notes: Line level alternative for the paging input

ports.label: Mic In
ports.notes: Balanced mic or line on Euroblock; +48 V phantom switchable; VOX; compatible with local input panel

ports.label: Pre Out
ports.notes: Line level after master volume; Euroblock

ports.label: Speaker Out
ports.notes: 4-pin 0.3 inch (7.6 mm) Euroblock: 4 ohm, 70 V, 100 V taps; use one only

ports.label: Priority Out
ports.notes: 24 V DC, 0.5 A max when priority is active; connector type not stated

ports.label: AC Power
ports.notes: 100-240 V AC mains inlet with power switch and fuse; inlet type not stated
